heading: top-center
name: 置中標題＋橫排步驟卡片與箭頭連接
desc: 置中的標題組下方，多個步驟項目橫排成一列、等寬等高，項目之間以箭頭連接；每個項目上方是序號標籤條，下方卡片裡是標題、說明文字與直式圖片。
prompt: 建立一個高度依內容而定的區塊。區塊上方置中放標題組，標題組包含標題（可多行），上方可放小標籤，下方可放副標與說明文字，沒有時省略；大標題明顯大於項目的標題。標題組下方是多個有順序的項目，橫向排成一列，對齊頁面內容寬度，項目等寬、等高，相鄰兩個項目之間放一個向右的箭頭圖示，位在卡片高度的中間。每個項目的最上方是一條橫跨項目寬度的序號標籤條，文字置中，和下方的卡片之間留少許空隙；卡片有自己的底色，上半部置中放標題與說明文字，下半部置中放一張直式圖片，文字和圖片之間留一段空白，圖片可貼齊卡片下緣、被卡片下緣裁切。
mobile: 項目改為橫向滑動，邊緣露出下一個項目的一部分：一次露出一個項目，約佔畫面寬的七成，第一個項目靠左對齊頁面內容寬度，右側露出下一個項目的一部分，延伸到畫面右緣。項目之間的箭頭圖示保留。標題組仍置中，項目內的組成不變。可用手指左右滑動切換。

en.name: Centered heading + horizontal step cards connected by arrows
en.desc: Below a centered heading group, multiple step items sit in one horizontal row, equal in width and height, connected by arrows; each item has a sequence label bar on top and a card below holding a title, a description and a portrait image.
en.prompt: Create a section whose height is determined by its content. Place the heading group at the top, centered. The heading group contains a title (may wrap to multiple lines), optionally with a label above and a subheading and description below; omit them when there is no content. The headline is noticeably larger than the item titles. Below the heading group are multiple ordered items laid out horizontally in one row, aligned to the page content width; the items are equal in width and height, and a right-pointing arrow icon sits between each pair of adjacent items, at the vertical middle of the cards. At the very top of each item is a sequence label bar spanning the item's width, with its text centered and a small gap between it and the card below; the card has its own background, with the title and description centered in its upper half and a single portrait image centered in its lower half, leaving a stretch of empty space between the text and the image; the image may be flush with the bottom edge of the card and cropped by it.
en.tablet: The tablet layout follows the mobile layout.
en.mobile: The items become horizontally swipeable, with part of the next item showing at the edge: one item is visible at a time, taking about seventy percent of the screen width, with the first item aligned left with the page content width and part of the next item showing on the right, extending to the right edge of the screen. The arrow icons between items are kept. The heading group stays centered and the composition of each item stays the same. Items can be switched by swiping left and right.
